_comment: Scoped permissions for the UNATTENDED weekly doc/IaC drift audit (doc-drift-audit.sh runs `claude -p --settings THIS --permission-mode default`). HARDENED after the 2026-06-30 adversarial review, which proved a prefix allowlist CANNOT enforce 'docs-only write / no exfil': shell redirection (`echo x > file`, empirically confirmed), write-flags on allowed tools (`sort -o`, `curl -o`), `git restore`, and `git push` all bypass path-scoping. FIX: the agent gets NO git, NO curl/wget, NO sops, NO sort — only reads, Edit/Write to docs+.audit-state, and the GET-only helper. The WRAPPER (trusted) owns ALL mutation: it stages ONLY doc paths, secret-scans the staged diff + the summary, and does the commit/push + issue-dispatch + email itself — so a prompt-injected agent cannot reach the Flux `main` branch or exfiltrate (its only outbound is the helper's UDM/GitHub GETs and a wrapper-scanned summary). The DENY list (deny beats allow + any source) hard-blocks the categorical disasters AND plaintext-secret Reads (age key / ~/.ssh / ~/.aws / ~/.claude). Empirical matcher facts: headless `default` hard-denies any unmatched Bash command; `$(...)` + `VAR=x cmd` env-prefixes are rejected; Edit/Write default-deny when an allowlist is present (so **/README.md allows component READMEs, nothing else is writable). Residual: the agent can READ a secret into context (no read tool is fully path-scopeable), but has no un-scanned channel to emit it. See doc-drift-audit-prompt.md + doc-drift-audit.sh + infra/devbox/README.md.
